groups.defect: The message handler validates origins using substring containment instead of exact origin equality.
groups.rationale: All three report the same check in embed.js and propose normalizing the expected origin before comparing it exactly.

groups.defect: Feed and remote imports leave fetch/parse failures and missing item/content/title values unhandled, while TopicEmbed.import also mutates caller-owned contents and fails on frozen or nil input.
groups.rationale: The feed suggestions overlap on nil content, and the two fetch suggestions report repeated unhandled external retrieval failures at separate open calls. The remote-import suggestion also explicitly reports the nil contents append identified by s_8924c5ce, connecting that suggestion's additional mutation and frozen-input defects.

groups.defect: The controller spec still expects synchronous TopicRetriever calls after the controller switched to enqueueing RetrieveTopic.
groups.rationale: These report the same controller/spec contract mismatch from opposite sides; updating the stale expectation addresses both.

groups.defect: The layout uses a full referer URL as postMessage targetOrigin and interpolates it into JavaScript without JavaScript escaping.
groups.rationale: Both report the targetOrigin formatting problem on the same statement. s_56e8eec5 additionally reports JavaScript injection, which the merged comment must preserve.
